q: An electric arc furnace mill asks our scrap yard for carbon data. What should we give?
title: Scrap dealer carbon data for EAF mills
short: Under CBAM, scrap enters a steel figure at zero embedded emissions, so the mill mainly needs proof of what is scrap. For footprints, give your own emissions per tonne handled: diesel for cranes and trucks, electricity for shears and balers, and transport to the mill.
audience: Scrap yards and dealers supplying electric arc and induction furnace mills

p: Scrap counts at zero, so records that show material is genuine scrap, by grade and source, matter more than a carbon figure.

ul: Diesel for cranes, loaders and trucks.
Electricity for shears, balers and shredders.
Transport to the mill, per tonne.

p: Divide by tonnes sold; the figure is usually small next to steelmaking.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
